title: 복붙 표 정리
summary: 인용된 셀과 다중행을 보존하는 로컬 표 정리, TSV·CSV·Markdown 복사 및 다운로드. 6개 언어 UI.
features: Quoted delimiters, escaped quotes and multiline cells
Independent trim, whitespace, blank row, empty column and flatten controls
Ragged row validation and optional explicit padding
Markdown HTML and pipe escaping, header choice

tests.name: node --check dist/app.js dist/core.js dist/table.js dist/i18n.js dist/common-i18n.js (each separately)

limitations: UTF-8 only, maximum 8 MB per file
Screen preview capped at 300 rows; exports include all
Formula prefix changes exported values and is not universal protection after spreadsheet re-saving
